disambiguation: The plugin manages archive history, metadata, and original file paths, going beyond simple file movement.
extras: Operates locally without network access or telemetry. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later.
intentEvidence: Integrated Archive moves files out of active work without treating them as disposable.
problem: Users lose valuable notes and attachments when they are deleted, and there is no easy way to temporarily remove files from active view while preserving them.
summary: A file management tool that moves notes and attachments to an archive instead of deleting them, allowing for restoration and metadata tracking.
